articles.title: Record-Shattering Teens Make a Splash at Sacramento Futures
articles.summary: Lauren Lonsdale, 14, surged to 4th all-time in the 13-14 girls' 400 IM with a 4:44, then won the 100 back. Natalia Lesniewska tied for 10th in the 100 free. Nathan Foucu broke 50 seconds for the first time.

articles.title: Buried Treasure: America's 250th Birthday Time Capsule Will Wait 250 Years
articles.summary: A time capsule filled with artifacts from all 50 states will be buried in Philadelphia on July 4, 2026, not to be opened until 2276. Contents range from a diamond to an AI prediction, sealed to survive centuries.

articles.title: From Stadium Surprise to Chart Supremacy: How 'Rein Me In' Made History
articles.summary: Sam Fender and Olivia Dean's "Rein Me In" has shattered the U.K. record for longest-running No. 1 single, with 19 weeks at the top. The collaboration was born from a last-minute live duet that ignited a cultural phenomenon.
